# Issue Labels

ClearView keeps issue labels small on purpose.

## Type
- `bug`: Something is broken.
- `improvement`: A small improvement to an existing behavior.
- `idea`: A new product idea that still needs judgment.
- `docs`: README, changelog, screenshots, or install notes.
- `maintenance`: Build scripts, tests, refactors, or project hygiene.

## Area
- `reminder`: Reminder popup, buttons, text, sound, and reminder flow.
- `rhythm`: Eye Relax / Pomodoro timing rules.
- `settings`: Settings UI, defaults, and preferences.
- `shortcuts`: Global shortcuts and shortcut settings.
- `distribution`: DMG, signing, Gatekeeper, and release packaging.

## Priority
- `P1`: Core flow is broken.
- `P2`: Noticeable user experience issue.
- `P3`: Nice to improve.

Use at most one type label, one area label, and one priority label per issue.
